t: The Output Port allows you to extract the re-processed material from the Reprocessor.$(br2)The graphical interface can be used to extract materials manually, or you can connect a pipe of some sort to extract them automatically.
输出端口允许你从再处理器中提取再处理后的材料。$(br2)你可以通过图形界面手动提取材料，也可以连接某种管道来自动提取。
$(l)Mandatory:$() one, and only one, is required$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() any vertical face (not on frame)$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() yes
$(l)必需：$()必须且只能有一个$(br)$(l)有效位置：$()任意竖直面（不能在框架上）$(br)$(l)图形界面：$()是
